name: Extracellular matrix
failures: Collagen crosslinking with age, basement membrane failure, scar deposition, elastin loss that never regenerates.

see.note: Histology on biopsy; almost nothing in a living person.

model.note: No specification exists for healthy matrix composition by tissue and age.

reach.note: Acellular and secreted — there is no cell to target for most of it.

edit.note: Crosslink breakers have repeatedly failed. Elastin is not replaced after development.

anchors: Elastin synthesis largely ceases after adolescence
